title: Jawaher: A Multidialectal Dataset of Arabic Proverbs for LLM Benchmarking
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the comprehension of Arabic proverbs (figurative language) across various dialects. While the authors note that proverbs reflect religious and societal values, the core evaluation is focused on linguistic performance, cultural nuance, and idiomatic translation rather than a dedicated assessment of religion, faith, or ethical systems.
